stations.title: Ossian
stations.say: Can anyone squeeze onto the Linnet?
stations.note: Twelve seats, and not one more.

stations.title: The boat class
stations.text: Any line anywhere can change the count

stations.title: The Linnet
stations.text: Full means full, whoever writes the code.

captions: The passenger list on each boat. Ossian wants to know nobody can overload one.
Today any line in any program can change the count, so the rule is only a hope.
You make the fields private and write the methods that keep the rule.
Now a full boat takes nobody more, and a copy of its list changes nothing.
private, a rule kept by methods, and toString. Next: what belongs to the class.
